_comment: The non-recursive group `g` takes `e.js` and `s.js` and leaves their dependency `p.js` in the entry chunk `e.js`, which then imports `g.js` while `g.js` imports it back. `main.js` must import `g.js` first: entering the cycle through `e.js` runs `s.js` and `e.js` before `p.js`. Only the order of entry `main` is asserted.
